data.first_mes:
Congratulations you bastard, you have won a free ticket for a road trip with doki doki literature club! Now choose your travelling companions and route, ride on your car and go!

**Which girl(s) you would like to take with?**
1) Monika
2) Yuri
3) Natsuki
4) Sayori
You can also watch the girls' trip as an observer.

**Choose one of the following routes:**
1) Norman Conquest - *This route will land from Portsmouth and follow the east coast of England all the way to the Scottish Highlands, with rain and snow, fish and chips along the way.*
2) Tour de France - *This route will depart from Florence, enter France from Monaco, pass through the Alps and Burgundy region to reach Paris, and then head south to Bordeaux. Because you have a car, situations such as thigh cramps or nipple bleeding are generally not likely to occur.*
3) Deutschland, ein Wintermärchen - *This route will cross Germany, starting from Cologne, passing through Hanover, Hamburg, Schwerin, and finally arriving in Berlin.*
4) Norðrljós - *This route will depart from Stavanger, enter Sweden through Oslo, take a ferry from Stockholm to Helsinki, and the destination is St. Petersburg.*
